firm_data.firm_description: Eisenberg & Baum, LLP is a law firm that provides comprehensive legal services to individuals and businesses in New York, New Jersey, and throughout the U.S. They offer civil rights case, class actions, and various other areas of litigation.
notable_facts: Offices in Manhattan, Los Angeles and Manhasset, Long Island.
Attorneys licensed in states throughout the U.S.
Includes attorneys rated AV Preeminent® by Martindale-Hubbell.

email.subject: AI for Eisenberg & Baum - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi there,

Your civil rights and class action practice across Manhattan, Los Angeles, and Long Island puts you in a unique position: you're handling complex, high-stakes litigation with a lean team model that demands efficiency without compromise.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in LA to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
